text: {"assertions":["A spurious 429 rate limit error was occurring in api/gateway/rate_limit.go.","The spurious 429 issue only appeared when two requests raced on the same key.","The root cause was a listener that was registered but never removed from the rate limiter.","The fix involved removing the listener during teardown and adding a test assertion to prevent regression.","The fix was implemented in PR #2892 on branch fix/spurious-429-1.","The issue was reproduced using a saved burst fixture.","The throttle counters exceeded the configured ceiling by far, which was the diagnostic signal for this bug.","After deployment of the fix, the backlog cleared 63 minutes later."]}
